email.subject: Iron Tide Fitness: two quick fixes worth checking
email.body:
Jack,

Looked at Iron Tide Fitness's site. Two things likely costing you signups: it's not mobile-friendly, and there's no way to book a class or trial online. Most people searching for a gym do it on their phone, and if they can't glance at your schedule and grab a spot right then, they move to the next listing.

I also noticed the page is slow to load (heavy images) and the footer still shows old info.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing what's losing you traffic and what I'd fix first, no pitch attached.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
